title: Velo Client 0.9.5
summary: A brand new animated title screen - a real 3D world with a live sword duel that glows in your theme color - two new themes, readable Monochrome and Nord, faster cosmetics, and a huge Velo+ Addons update with the Terminator.

blocks.text: 0.9.5 starts with the first thing you see: the title screen.

The old blurry background is gone. The new one is a **real 3D Minecraft world**, fully ray traced with soft sunset light, shadows and reflections - a ruined arena by a lake, a forest, mountains and a glowing portal. In the middle of it **two players fight a live sword duel**: slashes, shield blocks and sparks on every hit. The view slowly turns all the way around and loops without a seam.
The portal, the crystal pillars, the lanterns, the house windows and the drifting embers all **glow in your theme color** - switch themes and the whole world changes with it. Custom themes work too.

items: **Emerald** and **Sunset** are new built-in themes, in the game and in the launcher.
**Monochrome and Nord are readable again** - buttons, tabs, badges and toggles on their light accent colors now use dark text instead of white-on-white.
The same fix is in the launcher, so its buttons and selected rows stay readable with every theme.

blocks.caption: Monochrome: dark text on the light accent

items: **Cosmetics update faster** - when you change your cape, wings or aura, other players see it right away, and their changes reach you within seconds.
**Session Auto Fixer** now also reconnects by itself after "logging in too fast", "already connected" and busy-session kicks, waiting just as long as the server needs.
**Importing from other clients** is much faster and no longer marks mods as "not on Modrinth" when a big import hits Modrinth's rate limit.
**Smoother aura previews** in the launcher, and picture tiles for wings and auras in the collection.
**Redstone Mode**: bounding-box-only view, move a placement to where you stand, and stacked copies paste much faster (air in the copy can be skipped).

blocks.text: The biggest Addons update so far. As always, every module that acts for you only works in **singleplayer** or on servers in your **Private Servers** list.

items: **Terminator** - a bot that hunts one player on its own: it walks, parkours, swims, bridges, pillars and digs its way there, uses boats, and fights with crystals, anchors, bows and mace runs.
**Elytra Mace** and **Firework Mace** - full mace runs, and **Auto Cart** for TNT minecart hits.

New: **Auto Shield**, **Auto Dodge** (dodges arrows, tridents, fireballs and more), **Auto MLG**, **Auto Mend**, **Auto Extinguish**, **Criticals**, **W-Tap**, **Auto Walk**, **Auto Fish**, **Enemy Armor** and **Remove All Addons**.
**Auto Crystal** places a guard block so its blasts don't hit you, and can launch the target with a sword knock-up first. **Auto Anchor** shields itself too.
**X-Ray** outlines the blocks you can actually see, so you still know where to walk.
**Auto Eat** goes for golden apples when you need healing and also takes food from your inventory.

blocks.text: Velo+ members get the new Addons automatically on their next launch in profiles that already have them.
